Frequently Asked Questions

Why shall I hire expert Java developers from Mobilunity?

Our developers have a strong tech background and different levels of seniority, based on your project needs (5+ years). We stay up-to-date with the latest Java technologies and frameworks. Also, we offer competitive pricing and transparency, backed by strict quality assurance and support.

How are the interviews with developers conducted?

Doing our best to make hiring a maximum predictable and convenient venue, we conduct internal pre-screening before offering you a potential match. Once you select a candidate(s), we set up an interview with vetted Java developers for you to make a fully informed decision – and hire Java developers within weeks, not months.

How many Java developers can you hire for me?

Just as many as needed by your software development project. From an individual full-stack developer to fill a specific skill (or technology) gap – to a fully stacked dedicated team of Java developers built from scratch (for example, 4-10 highly skilled Java developers), we can get you covered.

How do you check the expertise of Java experts you offer for hire?

Putting quality and domain expertise first and foremost, we run a thorough screening and pre-vetting process. We analyze technical skills, proficiency in Java frameworks, taking into account experience in the industry, as well as soft skills like creative mindset, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

Can you assist with the Java developer technical interview?

We provide a full scope of assistance and tech consultation to help you hire top Java developers with the right skill set and tech stack. Eventually, you will receive an interview report with detailed feedback from all parties.

How do you ensure that my intellectual property is protected?

Putting your data security and intellectual property on top, we take care of all protection measures right from the initial consultancy. Starting from NDA to possible security concerns, we adhere to all primary compliance statements.

How much does it cost to hire a developer for our project?

Depending on your development needs and unique business requirements, we offer 2 flexible cooperation models to work for you at their best. Book a free consultation and tell us about your project – we’ll come back shortly to give you a personal cost estimate.

What domain expertise do your Java developers possess?

Our Java experts have extensive knowledge of the latest frameworks and extensions across different platforms (Java EE, J2EE, Jakarta EE). They have different proficiency levels working with popular Java libraries, architectures, tools & utilities, databases, as well as testing frameworks and external services.

Are there any hidden costs involved when we hire from Mobilunity?

Absolutely not. We keep you fully informed about all costs related to your specific case. Following the initial consultation, you’ll have a big picture of all expenses related to the process of expanding / building your team, with times of delivery, and additional services you may need (e.g. maintenance, ongoing support).

What are the skills required if you want to hire Java developers?

It’s desirable to have proficiency in JSP and Servlets, popular web frameworks like Struts and Spring, a basic understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, markup languages, and knowledge of Java Virtual Machine. You can book a professional consultancy service, should you lack some of these.
